executiveSummary: Iteration 000009 delivers the txt2audio end-to-end pipeline including model discovery (US-001), gateway validation (US-002), worker inference (US-003), and playground UI (US-004). The gateway layer, model config surface, handler registry, and frontend are largely compliant. However, two critical implementation gaps prevent the pipeline from running successfully at runtime: (1) the architecture loader key 'ace-step-15' in model_loader._LOADERS does not match the 'ace-step-1.5' string declared in models.config.json, causing a ValueError on model load; and (2) the _load_ace_step_15 loader omits the required VAE loading call and relies on a missing 'text_encoder' component that is absent from the model config. Additionally, the Txt2AudioHandler deviates from the specified pipeline in three ways: it skips the VAE decode step (vae.decode), uses scipy at 48kHz instead of torchaudio at 44.1kHz, and does not trim the trailing 5-second silence described in FR-5. FR-6 post-save existence check is also absent.
minorObservations: txt2audio.py uses scipy.io.wavfile at 48000 Hz instead of torchaudio.save at 44100 Hz as specified in FR-5/FR-6. The PRD explicitly requires torchaudio.save(str(output_path), waveform, 44100).
encode_ace_step_15_audio for the negative conditioning does not pass generate_audio_codes=False as specified in FR-5.

models.config.json for 'acestep-v15-base' is missing the 'text_encoder' and 'text_encoder2' components required by _load_ace_step_15 and specified in FR-4, which would cause a KeyError even if the architecture key mismatch were fixed.
_load_ace_step_15 in model_loader.py does not call manager.load_vae(), omitting VAE loading entirely. The PRD (FR-4) requires manager.load_vae(components['vae']).
The playground correctly hides the <audio> element until a result URL is received and displays errors visibly — no UI accessibility or UX issues found during review.
The SSE channel and job status endpoint (GET /v1/jobs/:id) correctly return status:'succeeded' and url — no gaps at the gateway communication layer.
conclusionsAndRecommendations: The implementation is architecturally sound and covers all four user stories at the structural level, but contains blocking runtime defects in the worker's model loading and inference pipeline that would prevent any actual txt2audio job from completing successfully. Recommended fixes in priority order: (1) Fix the architecture key in model_loader._LOADERS from 'ace-step-15' to 'ace-step-1.5' to match models.config.json. (2) Add 'text_encoder' and 'text_encoder2' component paths to the 'acestep-v15-base' model entry in models.config.json. (3) Update _load_ace_step_15 to call manager.load_vae(components['vae']) and manager.load_clip(components['text_encoder'], components['text_encoder2'], clip_type='ace'). (4) Update Txt2AudioHandler to call vae.decode(denoised['samples']) before saving, use torchaudio.save at 44100 Hz, pass generate_audio_codes=False for negative conditioning, and trim the last 5 seconds of the waveform (floor at 1 second minimum). (5) Add the post-save file existence check (FR-6) and raise RuntimeError if the file is not present after save.
